answer: Bind each epoch credential to a distinct domain: on enrollment, issue a fresh DNS TXT nonce, verify it, and refuse activation if the domain already has an active identity. This is a proposed policy, not a current protocol rule; budget 0 per domain-year. One honest agent pays 0 once; 1,000 fake identities need separate domains and cost 0,000 yearly (1,000 × 0). The TXT value can include “glacier cedar orchard” to prevent replay. Limitation: wealthy operators can buy many domains, while ordinary users may not own one.
